reviews.t: New Pumps Work Great!
reviews.x: I had posted previously that I was disappointed in these bottles because, if I had essential oil blends in the bottles, the pumps would stick after only a week or so of use.  I brought this to the attention of the supplier and they promptly shipped out new pumps from a different manufacturer.  I am happy to report these pumps are working great with my essential oil blends!  Thanks for great customer support!

reviews.t: Will not buy again.
reviews.x: The sprayer/mister sticks after being pressed down. It has to be manually lifted to spray again.  Five stars for the sellers only. The sellers contacted me and sent a set of replacement sprayers, which worked fine, for a short while. But now one has started sticking again. I have other cobalt blue bottles with white sprayers for years with which I have never had a problem. So I do not know why these are such a problem. Anyway, the sellers did try to remedy the situation, so I have rated the sell

reviews.t: Great bottles but pumps clog
reviews.x: I love the bottles themselves however I used four of them for holiday gifts of various sprays including essential oils. Everyone indicated to me that the pumps got stuck after a couple of days of use. I also noticed my pumps stopped working after a couple of days of use. Even soaking in very hot water and running under hot water for several minutes did not help.

reviews.t: Getting a ton of use out of these bottles already!
reviews.x: I keep a ton of essential oils on hand to make various linen sprays, cleaners, and aromatherapy blends. All I was missing were these bottles! I went nuts with these yesterday, making my own "poopourri" type spray for the bathroom, a lavender linen spray for my daughter, and a bug repellent using lemon eucalyptus oil. All my concoctions sprayed easily and evenly, so not only are these bottles adorable to look at, but they function very well. I used chalk markers on the labels since they w

reviews.t: Multiple uses. Environmentally friendly.
reviews.x: These are terrific multiuse bottles. They are safer, more durable and more environmentally friendly than plastic containers. I have used them for very thin liquids like apple cider vinegar and also for very thick substances like walnut oil and milk of magnesia. I have some in the bathroom for beauty use, two in the kitchen for food use and one in the diaper bag with vinegar water for on the go sippy cup or table top sanitizing. These bottles are also great for storing essential oil concoctions.

reviews.t: Good quality bottles and cute labels!
reviews.x: I've been very happy with this set of bottles and labels. I've used them for a variety of beauty and household products that contain essential oils- mostly recipes from WellnessMama.com. I believe I've used 5 out of the 6 so far and the spray nozzles all work perfectly. I'm always a little nervous ordering glass but they arrived well packed and in pristine condition. I emailed the seller and they told me that if my essential oil mixture is too thick, the spray heads will get clogged. My mixture was not thick, but I watered it down anyway, and cleaned the spray heads very well. It still didn't work. I'm giving it 2 stars because the customer service was very good. reviews.t: Ok
reviews.x: I use these bottles for essential oil mixes, magnesium oil and any other concoction I am currently cooking up around the house. The bottles work great for awhile but eventually start leaking around the nozzle. It seems like once I take off the cap, clean/dry they work better but it is an inconvenience. I will continue to buy this product in the future because I have not found any bottles that do not leak at the cap so far and I like the blue bottles. Would recommend to others.

reviews.t: I have had some in the past that worked great, these not so much
reviews.x: Used my bottle a few times and then the sprayer part no longer worked it would go down but not come back up, I have to pull it up to spray again.  It also seems to leak - when you shake it the liquid flies out of the bottle. I have had some in the past that worked great, these not so much...

reviews.t: These bottles are beautiful cobalt blue bottles
reviews.x: I purchased these items for creating essential oils products for cleaning, health, and first aid.  These bottles are beautiful cobalt blue bottles, and the perfect size to fit into medicine cabinet. I love that they came with labels.

reviews.t: One has worked fine; the other one has not.
reviews.x: The bottles were what I was looking for, but I have only used 2 of them so far.  Of those two, one is working fine but the other, the sprayer has stopped working. It sticks when you push it down and it doesn't come back up.

reviews.t: Don't buy
reviews.x: These are pretty and sturdy, but the pumps don't work very well at all. They keep sticking and I have to manually pull the nozzle up after each spray. Very frustrating. Will not purchase again.

The spray opening is not clogged, and emits a generous fine spray, but the pump spring does not return. I use a very diluted essential oil mix in the bottles. reviews.x: I LOVE the color of the bottles that rich cobalt - Fantastic.  The sprayers weren't "as fantastic" when the sprayer is pushed down it doesn't pop back up.  Now that being said - - RG Seller's Customer Service is TOP NOTCH!! reviews.t: I ordered these to use with homemade mixtures of essential ...
reviews.x: I ordered these to use with homemade mixtures of essential oils & water, etc for body sprays, air fresheners, etc. I have used three bottles & so far all three of them have defective sprayers. After each pump, you have to physically pull the sprayer back up in order to spray again. VERY inconvenient! After the third one, I decided to return them, but just discovered that I missed the return window by 2 days.

reviews.t: The set is a perfect amount for someone who is beginning their own spray ...
reviews.x: The blue of the bottle gives a unique color to the sample set for the oils and sprays that are made. The glass is very high quality along with even the sprayer itself. The set is a perfect amount for someone who is beginning their own spray sets for their own store, or even if they wanted to have it as travel bottles for different smells to carry with them.

reviews.t: These are beautiful and the glass seems to be fairly good quality
reviews.x: These are beautiful and the glass seems to be fairly good quality, however, the sprayers seem to be lacking. Mine frequently have trouble coming back up once I've depressed it so I end up having to wait a second or two before spraying again. Annoying but since only about half of the sprayers have this issue I'm still giving 3 stars.

reviews.t: Sprayer doesn't work properly!
reviews.x: I love the color of the bottles and all the things that came with it. The price is okay but my problem is the fact that I love to spray more than once but the sprayer will only goes one time and it doesn't retract on its own. I have not tried the others yet, I hope they're not all like this.

claims.text: Many reviewers report that the sprayer or pump tops stick or stop working after a short period of use, requiring manual lifting to spray again.
Several reviewers praise the bottles themselves as sturdy, beautiful, and good quality, often noting the cobalt blue glass and included labels.
Some reviewers mention leaking around the nozzle or liquid escaping when shaken.
Multiple reviewers note the seller was responsive and sent replacement pumps or sprayers.
Several reviewers successfully use the bottles for essential oil blends, homemade sprays, and other household or beauty products.
